compat.notes: Parity vs PyTorch CPU fp32 on 8 synthetic fixtures and MPS/MLX timings: docs/research/mlx-cpp-ffi.md, benchmarks/apple/mlx/. Becomes VALIDATED only after task 12 (native Rust+MLX end-to-end parity) passes; only measured on an M4 Max. The model file is not published anywhere: install by offline import of a locally converted file.

provenance.notes: audio_tower of the Google base (text/vision towers dropped) with the 96 LoRA pairs (r16, alpha32) merged in fp32 as W + 2.0*B@A, conv weights transposed to MLX layouts (OIHW->OHWI, depthwise CK->KC), Reader GRU repacked to MLX gate layout, all fp32 in one safetensors file (tensor metadata format tingmix-large-mlx). Environment: mlx 0.32.4, mlx-vlm 0.7.8, transformers 5.19.0 (experiments/macos/mlx/uv.lock). Lower precisions are produced at load time.
